name: micme
description: Use your phone as a mic, camera and screen for your computer, plus two-way file sharing, over hotspot, Wi-Fi or USB.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.mobile:apk: cd mobile && npx eas-cli@latest build -p android --profile preview
scripts.test: npm --prefix desktop test && cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit
